items.question: What specific extraordinary attainments are named here alongside prior ritual results in this Śrīvidyā instruction?
premises: The verse lists named attainments as a continuation of prior ritual outcomes.
Entry into another body and entry into a city are presented as concrete results.
The term likewise ties these items to the preceding sequence of effects.
items.inference: The instruction enumerates further siddhi-like attainments—entering another body and entering a city—placed in the same series as earlier ritual fruits.
uncertainties: Exact ritual context and conditions for these attainments are not specified in these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: And entering another body, and entering a city—likewise (named among these results).
